name: Human Dignity
overview: Scripture reveals that human dignity is rooted in being created in God's own image, as affirmed in Genesis 1:27, which establishes the inherent worth of every person. Children are described as a heritage from the Lord, highlighting the value God places on human life (Psalms 127:3). The teachings of Christ emphasize loving others as oneself and treating others as we would want to be treated, underscoring the call to respect and mercy toward all people (Matthew 7:12; Mark 12:31; Luke 6:36). This dignity is also reflected in the relationship between disciple and master, indicating humility and mutual respect within human interactions (Matthew 10:24).
